title: paeonia foemina proles humilis
intro: Paeonia foemina proles humilis, commonly known as  Paeonia lactiflora var. humilis, is a plant species in the Paeoniaceae family, typically used as a medicinal herb. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia foemina proles humilis include sedation, anxiolysis, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include paeonol, paeoniflorin, and paeonillin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
